packageRules.description: linuxserver.io tags carry -lsN (socket-proxy also -rN); Docker versioning treats that as a suffix and finds nothing newer.
Actions: one PR for minor, patch and digest updates
Major versions of container images (databases, search, brokers) need a data migration or a matching client: Renovate lists them in the Dependency Dashboard and opens a PR only when it is ticked there
EMQX 5.9 and later are BSL 1.1: free only as single nodes, and wgkex runs a four-node cluster (docker04-07). Stay on the last Apache-2.0 line until wgkex has another broker.
MongoDB 8.0 is the LTS line and the newest UniFi Network supports (docker05); 8.1+ are rapid releases with a one-way featureCompatibilityVersion. Komodo (docker06) follows the same pin
ClickHouse LTS only (x.3 and x.8), as akvorado's own versions.yml does
CI tests dhcp-server in the Python of Salt's onedir (3008.3: 3.14); raise together with Salt
bgpalerter copies the node binary into its Alpine 3.19 image; node 23+ needs libatomic, which that image lacks
Core and Periphery run the same version
Collector (Salt) and analyzer image (stacks/) are released together
Release assets are verified by sha256 in defaults.yaml, Renovate cannot fill them in
prBodyNotes: Add the sha256 of every release asset to `defaults.yaml` in this PR before merging, otherwise `source_hash` fails.
Check that the release builds against the gateway kernels (comment in `systemd-networkd/init.sls`) and move the old version to `batman_old_versions`.
